σκανδάλ-ηθρον , τό,
A.stick in a trap on which the bait is placed, and which, when touched by the animal, springs up and shuts the trap, Poll. 7.114 , 10.156 : metaph., σκανδάληθρ᾽ ἱστὰς ἐπῶν setting word-traps, i.e. throwing out words which one's adversary will catch at, and so be caught himself,
Ar. Ach. 687 , ubi v. Sch., cf. Cratin. 457 ; cf. σκάνδαλον.
From A Greek-English Lexicon (Henry George Liddell, Robert Scott, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1940)
